leg runs: 0. Verification machinery only: the suite's first live
invocation is a promotion leg owned by the release rows; this row proves
it against fixture trees and the composed `release-serving` stack.
Stamps **SIG-REL-007** (`Also:` — Owner: P35.58 lands suite B: V6–V10 +

## What landed

- **`ops/src/ops/release_verify.py`** (new) — the suite. Each check emits
  a `sig.release-verify/1` row — `check`, `mode`, `status`
  (`pass`/`fail`/`skip` only), `detail`, `evidence`, `duration`, origin +
  `origin_kind` — persisted per check plus a suite document under
  `--results-dir` (append-only; reruns write new files).
  - **V1 integrity** — `exports.release.validate_release` complete;
    descriptor digest recomputes to the pub id; every <1 MiB
    integrity-manifest artifact fetched over HTTP and sha256-matched;
    larger/record files take a deterministic stratified 2 % sample (S) /
    200-artifact cap (P); unfetchable or mismatched → fail. The
    full-tree monthly audit is recorded as a later row's, never
    substituted.
  - **V2 identity and clock** — descriptor v2; `environment=production`;
    40-hex pushed/clean commit; no `0.0.0`; the §3.3 rules; label
    uniqueness; `as_of_world` strictly newer than the current latest's.
    Repo or latest facts unevaluable → honest `skip` (which blocks).
  - **V3 allow-list and absence** — emitted route set vs
    `ops/public_routes.toml`; content assertions (curate banner, loopback
    form actions, `demo_*`, `presentation/`); denied routes
    (`/curate/`, `/intake/`, `/research-dossier/`, unpromoted
    `/r/<other>/`) → 404; `/releases/` excluded as pipeline-owned.
  - **V4 stamp and manifest** — every HTML page in the namespaces carries
    exactly one matching `sig-release` meta, one `describedby` link whose
    target re-reads equal `release.json` fields, one visible stamp block;
    `X-SIG-Release` on every response (P mode: equals `latest.json`'s
    pair).
  - **V5 link crawl and containment** — every same-origin href answers
    200 or a declared 410 (P caps at 200 by sha256 order); `s/<pub>/`
    links stay in-prefix bar `/r/<pub>/`, `/releases/` and
    `rel="latest-version"` targets.
  - **V11 zero-JS / budgets / a11y** — no `<script>` on content pages;
    `web/tests/e2e/page-budgets.json` ceilings; real axe via
    **`web/scripts/axe_scan.mjs`** (Playwright Chromium +
    `@axe-core/playwright`) over the Lighthouse URL set + landing + one
    snapshot page; missing budgets/runner/browser → `skip`; serious and
    critical violations fail.
  - **V12 scrub and secrets** — `policy.transparency.find_secrets` over
    every publish-set file; one hit fails; evidence names
    file/line/detector class, never the secret; never waivable.
  - **V13 disclosures** — descriptor disclosure ids exist in
    `ops/disclosures.toml`, digests recompute equal, required renderings
    present, the "API is live" line on stamped pages, eval wording never
    overclaims `evaluation.status`.
- **`sig-ops release verify`** — `--mode S|P`, repeatable `--origin` +
  `--origin-header` (the staging identity token), `--tree` (the local
  fixture origin — `origin_kind: "tree"`, never a staging/public claim),
  `--results-dir`, `--class`, `--waiver 'V<n>=<readout-ref>'` (Class-S
  only, recorded, V12 exempt), `--repo-root`/`--no-repo-probe`/
  `--repo-facts`. No `--mode` → the pre-P35.56 bounded scope verbatim.
  No origin → every check `skip`s → suite blocked. `--apply` journals
  `verified` (S) / `verified-p` (P, a non-lifecycle kind — never re-folds
  the state machine) or `failed`; a blocked suite raises
  `verify-failed`.
- **Waiver contract** — `V<n>=<readout-ref>` refs; Class-S only; ignored
  waivers (wrong class, malformed, V12) recorded with reasons; any
  uncovered failure or skip keeps the suite blocked.

## Tests

- `tests/ops/test_release_verify.py` — 24 tests: the fixture candidate
  (a real v2 build + site trees + registry conf gens), the green S suite,
  the JSON row contract, skip-blocks, the waiver rule, and the
  seeded-defect catalog — one planted defect per check, each failing its
  check with evidence.
- `tests/e2e/test_release_verify_composed.py` — 3 tests over the real
  `release-serving` compose profile: S green over `web-staging`; a
  tampered staged byte → V1 fail → `verify-failed` + journaled `failed`;
  P mode over `web` — promoted-map gate + `X-SIG-Release`/`X-SIG-Conf-Gen`
  verified; the suite blocks on **exactly** the recorded `D-P35.56-1`
  finding.

## Findings filed

- **`D-P35.56-1` (OPEN)** — the composed P leg caught a real serving gap:
  `/releases/catalog.jsonld` (the DCAT series catalog every stamped page
  links via `rel="alternate"`) is deny-gated 404 publicly — the
  `/releases/` prefix only passes `p-<pub>` paths and the conf
  generation's `releases/` set doesn't carry it. Owner: the
  release-serving generation row. Reported loudly; never smoothed.
